description: This file defines the EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee attendance records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, and deleting attendance records, with validation and permission checks.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing employee attendance records, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting entries. Implements validation, permission checks, and handles various attendance workflows.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list an employee's attendance records with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new attendance punch record for an employee.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified attendance records for an employee, with permission verification.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to punch out an employee, updating the last punch-in record with punch out details.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves employee number parameter from the request.

methods.name: getCommonRequestParams
methods.description: Extracts common parameters used in create and update operations such as date, time, timezone info, and note.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchInActions
methods.description: Verifies if the user has permission to perform punch-in actions.

methods.name: userAllowedPunchOutActions
methods.description: Verifies if the user has permission to perform punch-out actions.

methods.name: extractPunchDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from input date-time string and timezone offset.

methods.name: setPunchInAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets fields for a punch-in attendance record with provided parameters.

methods.name: setPunchOutAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Sets fields for a punch-out attendance record with provided parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET all endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Method not implemented, but typically would fetch a single attendance record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Method not implemented, but would provide validation for fetching one record.
